# Edgecase Wait

Edgecase Wait is a pay-per-use event-driven waiting service for autonomous agents.

- Site: https://wait-site.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/
- API: https://wait.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/
- OpenAPI: https://wait.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/openapi.json
- API catalog: https://wait.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/.well-known/api-catalog
- Offer: $0.01 per wait, one future JSON event, 60 seconds through 24 hours.
- Delivery: bounded at-least-once callback delivery; deduplicate by wait_id.
